description: This file defines the GatewayDiscoveryModel class, which manages discovery and monitoring of network gateways using Bonjour/mDNS browsing through Network framework. It handles starting/stopping discovery, parsing network results, managing state, and logging debug info.

classes.name: GatewayDiscoveryModel
classes.description: A final class managing network gateway discovery, status, debug logging, and maintaining a list of discovered gateways.

classes.name: GatewayDiscoveryModel.DebugLogEntry
classes.description: A struct representing individual debug log entries with timestamp and message.

classes.name: GatewayDiscoveryModel.DiscoveredGateway
classes.description: A struct representing a discovered network gateway with identifying information and network details.

methods.name: setDebugLoggingEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables debug logging; clears logs when disabled and adds entry when enabled.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Begins network discovery using Bonjour/mDNS for predefined service domains.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops all ongoing network discovery and clears stored gateways and states.

methods.name: recomputeGateways
methods.description: Recalculates and sorts the list of gateways based on current discovered targets.

methods.name: updateStatusText
methods.description: Updates the overall status string based on current browsing states.

methods.name: prettyState
methods.description: Converts NWBrowser.State enum values to human-readable strings.

methods.name: appendDebugLog
methods.description: Adds a debug message to the log if logging is enabled, maintaining max log size.

methods.name: prettifyInstanceName
methods.description: Normalizes gateway/instance names by removing specific suffixes and whitespace.

methods.name: txtValue
methods.description: Extracts and trims a string value from a dictionary for a given key.

methods.name: txtIntValue
methods.description: Parses an integer value from a string value in a dictionary for a given key.

methods.name: txtBoolValue
methods.description: Interprets a string value from a dictionary as a boolean.
